title: Review queue: inline-correct flagged rows
userStory: As a user I can fix a flagged receipt field (e.g. wrong VAT) so the row passes validation before I export.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/reviewQueue.js exports applyCorrection(rows, index, patch) that returns a NEW rows array with the patched fields and re-computed validation status (pure — never mutates input).
Correcting a flagged VAT so net+vat is approximately gross clears that row's needs-review flag; a correction that is still inconsistent keeps the flag with its reason.
An out-of-range index throws a clear error.
npm test passes with acceptance cases covering: correction clears a flag, correction still-invalid keeps flag, immutability of input, bad index throws.
